Session 3 — T3.2 (backend + API half); Contracts C2 find_duplicates/merge_items, C3 duplicates/merge routes

## Done when

find_duplicates wraps the existing TIER-2 prefilter + dedup.resolve_duplicate scorer (no embedding → no candidates); merge_items runs as one transaction where the survivor inherits both items' collections, tags and entity mentions plus the stronger read-state/favorited signal; FTS handled via _delete_item_cascade; self-merge refused; GET /api/knowledge/items/{id}/duplicates + POST /api/knowledge/items/{id}/merge (survivor in path, loser in body, confirm:true required)
